1. ReSO AI

Tagline: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI
Description: ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

2. Onepin

Tagline: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right
Description: AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. Onepin runs on the voices you already use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, 30+ more), spells out prices and dates, checks names against a 4M-word pronunciation dictionary, scores every line, and fixes the wrong word without re-rendering the take. Built for teams shipping AI voiceover in several languages: product videos, dubbing, courses. Free to start, no credit card required.

3. Claude Dashboards & Motion

Tagline: Ask Claude for live dashboards and animated explainers
Description: Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are beta artifacts in Claude. Dashboards connects to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse or Salesforce and turns a plain language question into a live dashboard that refreshes as your data changes, with the query behind every number. Motion turns reports, charts and walkthroughs into short animations written as code, so you can edit any word, number or timing, then export an MP4. Dashboards is on paid plans, Motion on Team and Enterprise.

4. Microsoft-Decision-1

Tagline: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows
Description: Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Give it fixed options and it returns a calibrated probability for each in a single pass, as structured output software can act on directly. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B, it is about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency, per Microsoft. Available now in Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output.

5. Cue

Tagline: Put your AirPods in, your Mac starts focusing
Description: Your headphones become a focus switch. Put your AirPods in and your Mac turns on your Focus mode, blocks distracting sites and starts a timer in the notch. Take them out: break time, sites come back. Also in the notch: now playing, volume and brightness, your own colors, session history and two tiny buddies that react to everything. Free, private, macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. Vibe-coded by one person and Claude.

7. Skreno

Tagline: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser
Description: Skreno is a video studio in your browser: record, edit and share in one place. Record your screen and camera as separate tracks, then edit in Studio: pick a layout, cut silences, and add animated captions and titles. Share one link with a transcript, AI summary and comments on the exact second. Send a request link and anyone can record for you, no account needed. Bug reports come with the console log attached.

8. Maildun for Mac

Tagline: Design on-brand emails by hand, with AI, or over MCP
Description: Maildun for Mac is an agentic email builder for macOS. Design by hand in the drag-and-drop editor, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok with your own API key: the assistant edits your design live, as a proposal you accept or reject. Turn on the built-in MCP server and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can create and edit emails too. Plus workspaces per client, brand kits with shadcn-style component styles, saved sections, media on your own R2 or S3 bucket, and publishing to maildun.com.

9. Skymir

Tagline: Google Drive sync for Linux
Description: Skymir mirrors your Google Drive folders to Linux with two-way sync, double-click Google Docs shortcuts, and a native GTK tray. Local saves upload within seconds; changes made in Drive arrive within about a minute. Deletes go to the trash on both sides, and a sync that would delete more than half your files is refused. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial, no subscription.

10. Lune

Tagline: The search engine built for scientific AI agents
Description: Lune is Exa.ai for scientific research. It connects AI agents to research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows, and provides high-quality knowledge grounding based on papers from top-tier academic conferences. 10x the efficiency and trustworthiness of literature review, experimental design, writing and peer review. From early ideas to publication, it helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper grounding, and rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.
